source.snippet: I want to pass multiple values from CRMA Analytics Dashboard to Salesforce - on click of cell. Now I've Table widget which is showing data coming from SAQL. Also, I'm using Text widget - where I'm trying to launch a Flow with mapped value (using Interaction). But while click on cell in Table - not able to retain the selection/selected value and then clicking on Text widget - it passes null values to Flow. The requirement is to pass multiple values (other than recordId) from CRMA Dashboard to a Flow.

problem_statement: Salesforce CRM Analytics (CRMA) developers cannot reliably pass multiple non-recordId field values from dashboard widget interactions into Salesforce Flows, causing null-value errors that block dashboard-driven automation use cases.
target_segment: Salesforce developers and CRM Analytics consultants at companies using Salesforce Sales/Service Cloud with Einstein Analytics dashboards
notes: Buyer signal: professional Salesforce developer/consultant context. Companies pay significant Salesforce licensing fees; CRMA is an add-on SKU. Consultants bill by the hour resolving these integration gaps. A Salesforce AppExchange component or consulting accelerator that bridges CRMA widget interactions to Flow inputs would have clear paying buyers. Single signal but a well-known class of CRMA limitation.
